### Observed differences

- In the later window, activities A16, A17, A18 and A19 each appear in about 77% of traces, up from about 22%; activities A20, A21, A22 and A23 each appear in about 23% of traces, down from about 79%. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC008]
- The outgoing behaviour of A15 shifted: before, about 79% of its transitions went to A23 and 22% to A19; after, about 77% go to A19 and 23% to A23. [DIR001]
- A15 now co-occurs with A16–A19 in about 77% of traces (up from 22%) and with A20–A23 in about 23% (down from 79%). A16–A19 and A20–A23 never co-occur in either window, so they behave as mutually exclusive alternatives. [REL001, REL004, REL005, REL008, REL012, REL015, REL019, REL022, REL025, REL028, REL030, REL033]
- A27 is present in all traces; its co-occurrence with A16–A19 rises from about 22% to 77%, while its co-occurrence with A20–A23 falls from about 79% to 23%. [REL016, REL023, REL029, REL034, REL038, REL041, REL043, REL044]

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence

The evidence is insufficient to infer a structural change in the process. The observed differences all reflect a single underlying shift in the branch taken after A15, and one distinct difference is not clearly more than the 0.67 items expected by chance under no change. [SCREENING]
